elements.label: Frozen Arthur
elements.description: Caught in time's icy grip, Arthur, once a chronologer of secrets, lies in wait for the moment of his revival. [You might be able to recruit this follower once again.]

elements.label: Frozen Beatrice

elements.label: Frozen Charles
